outcomeNote: A single anonymous mishna clause with no dispute and no named parties, so no interaction between parties is asserted.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שְׁנַיִם שֶׁלָּקְחוּ פָּרָה וּבְנָהּ, אֵיזֶה שֶׁלָּקַח רִאשׁוֹן יִשְׁחוֹט רִאשׁוֹן, וְאִם קָדַם הַשֵּׁנִי – זָכָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «two» people «who purchased a cow and its offspring,» where each purchased one of the animals, «whoever purchased» his animal «first shall slaughter» it «first,» and the second one must wait until the next day to slaughter his animal, so as not to violate the prohibition of: It and its offspring. «But if the second» one «preceded» him and slaughtered his animal first, he «benefitted,» and the one who purchased the animal first may not slaughter it until the next day.

moves.summary: the earlier purchaser slaughters first, yet a second who preceded him keeps the day
